name: dot-grid-wallpaper
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Dot Grid style. Wallpaper variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#22D3EE, #155E75, #071013, #ECFEFF). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
